sentence: This project builds a center that produces metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data to help find out how nutrition and the microbiome affect human health.
This project builds instruments and methods that make images of molecules at high chemical and spatial resolution using mass spectrometry.
This project tries to find ways to make more natural products from cyanobacteria and sponge-associated microbes for drug discovery and development.
This project studies how upper respiratory virus infection causes asthma attacks through cross talk between the nose and lung.
This project measures how fast RNA is processed and tries to find genetic variants that change the rates across human cell lines.
This project tries to find out whether early-life abnormalities of the skin affect the immune system and lead to the allergic march.
This project uses machine learning to predict what metabolites gut bacteria make and how these link to cardiovascular disease.
This project builds an ionization source that works with mass spectrometers in analytical laboratories.
This project studies how sensing of a certain kind of RNA affects T cells and tumors in melanoma.
This project investigates how a long non-coding RNA and its regulatory variant affect ovarian aging.
This project sorts people with prediabetes into groups with different cardiometabolic risk profiles.
This project develops tools to target parts of the hippocampus, which is responsible for memory and spatial navigation.
This project tests whether a therapy made of invariant Natural Killer T cells can improve hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
This project studies how a cytokine activates liver sinusoidal endothelial cells to cause inflammation in alcoholic hepatitis.
This project studies how epithelial sodium channels in dendritic cells and monocytes affect blood pressure.
This project uses clinical and genetic information of patients to evaluate how opioid drugs affect pain relief after surgery and adverse drug events.
This project studies how adverse daily experiences and present bias explain differences in weight loss outcomes.
This project tests imaging methods as markers to identify the molecular diagnosis and monitor patients with primary progressive aphasia.
This project provides support for a biocontainment laboratory that offers facilities to help respond to emerging pathogens.
This project studies how human tumor viruses cause cancer and works to find targets for anti-viral, anti-tumor therapies.
